notes.title: Release"AbsentedAge: Squarebound International Upgrade Bundle"
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23833/AbsentedAge/

This is an upgrade bundle for owners of " [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387580/AbsentedAge_Squarebound/]AbsentedAge: Squarebound[/url]". (Original, vanilla version).
This bundle makes owner of the original game to upgrade to “[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1615930/_/][International] Absented Age: Squarebound[/url]" for the same price as the standalone DLC released on other sales platforms.

In addition to save data compatibility, you can unlock extra contents by dropping the "international DLC.patch file" into the original version's "patches" folder.
As an added bonus for this pack, 4 different gear sets from previous campaigns such as the Shamanic Gear, can be obtained by playing the game with this DLC installed!
